name: Weather Destroying The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly uses weather phenomena such as hail, frost, and stormy winds as instruments of judgment and correction upon the earth. The LORD cast down great hailstones to defeat Israel’s enemies (Joshua 10:11) and brought destruction to crops and trees through hail and frost (Psalms 78:47). These natural forces fulfill His word and demonstrate His power to discipline unrepentant hearts, as seen when He smote His people with blasting, mildew, and hail to call them back to Himself (Haggai 2:17; Isaiah 28:2). Thus, weather destroying the earth serves as a visible testimony of God's righteous authority and warning to mankind.
